# Office-design maintenance and historical input

The current workflow body, token-contract reference, validator logic and four theme palettes in this directory are independently authored Firefly maintenance based on generic document needs and the actual PDF, XLSX, DOCX and PPTX interfaces. The existing Skill frontmatter, filenames, required token keys, validator CLI contract and useful original regression assertions are retained for compatibility. Current maintenance is not a claim that all repository content is original Firefly work.

Historical office-design input is traced by the distributed `license-provenance.json` and `LICENSE-NOTICES.md` to Playa-0v0/Cyrene-Agent, including commit `edca2be98b1899769d18faa7239ba7b398ef13c6`. The verified MIT revision is `734bfeeab97b0cdaf5a29ee8fd8f0d61efb88948`; its complete license and `Copyright (c) 2026 Playa` notice remain in `../../licenses/upstream-contributions-MIT.txt`. Preserve that license and the distributed provenance records with this directory. Historical per-file hashes describe historical input; they are not byte-identity assertions for these rewritten files.

This scoped maintenance does not rewrite historical provenance records, relicense adjacent document Skills, or clear any unresolved source review. The current formal snapshot and `license-provenance.json.currentDistribution` identify these maintained files by hash. MiniMax, other upstream authors and external programs retain their own applicable notices and licenses. No permission to run tools, install dependencies or redistribute third-party libraries is granted by this notice.
